item.title: [DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Tue 19:17): Landeseigene erhöhen Mieten | Pflegereform Brandenburg | Höchstes Windrad
item.description:
Originally published Tue 29 Sep 2026 19:17 IDT.
Die landeseigenen Wohnungsunternehmen erhöhen derzeit ihre Mieten – was viele Mieter sauer macht - und auch auf der politischen Bühne Fragen aufwirft. Außerdem: Brandenburgs Blick auf Pflegereform; Höchstes Windrad in Schipkau ist fertig; Aktionswoche gegen Lebensmittelverschwendung.   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Wed 07:53): AI bosses sign self-regulation accord
item.description:
Originally published Wed 30 Sep 2026 07:53 IDT.

After talks with AI industry executives at the White House, President Trump says they've signed a deal to police themselves which is "morally binding". Meanwhile, he has ruled out a joint venture with China on Artificial Intelligence, saying it would amount to "giving away secrets" to Ameria's main economic rival. Also: South Africa's president Cyril Ramaphosa addresses the nation amid growing alarm about violence against women. The English Premier League confirms Manchester City have been found guilty of serious breaches of its financial rules. A man who spent 41 years on death row in the US for murder is released on bail after newly analysed DNA evidence did not link him to the crime. The UK's Prime Minister Andy Burnham sets out an ambitious agenda in a major speech to his party. A rare painting of Rome by the renowned artist William Turner returns to the eternal city. And a week-long dance-a-thon in Nigeria.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight.
